mapper.sql: ( select di.business_id finprod_market_id, di.institution_code, di.belong_institution_code belongInstitutionCode, di.model_type from DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST di where di.model_type = '02' and DI.DATA_TYPE = 'PTL01')

sql.if: ( select (case ba.asset_code when null then cd.asset_id ELSE ba.asset_code end) asset_code, di.belong_institution_code belongInstitutionCode, di.model_type from DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST di LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA CD ON cd.prod_id=di.business_id LEFT JOIN chb_bot_ast_pos ba on cd.asset_id = ba.plan_asset_id where di.model_type = '02' and DI.DATA_TYPE = 'PTL01' GROUP BY ba.asset_code,cd.asset_id,di.belong_institution_code,di.model_type)

GROUP BY rep_code UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS warnnum, rep_code, count( check_result ) failnum, 0 AS warningnum FROM chb_report_check WHERE check_result = '02' AND DATE_FORMAT( DATA_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = DATE_FORMAT( #{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},'%Y-%m-%d')
GROUP BY rep_code) b GROUP BY rep_code
